title: Abyss And Desert Plugin
description:
You can`t fall to void.
And be roof the nether)
body:
This plugin no longer allows you to die in the abyss and move around the roof of hell (_**you don't want to lose things, do you?**_). You can also configure the following settings:

- /abyssconfig reload — reloading the configuration.

- /abyssmessage legal <true/false> — enabling or disabling messages.

- /abyssmessage kill — disabling all messages.

- /abyssevent PlayerInVoid <true/false> — enabling or disabling teleportation from the void.

- /abyssevent PlayerNetherRoof <true/false> — enables or disables damage on the roof of hell.
